docs.summary: Escape hatches for working out where an artifact comes from. Every one of these makes the bake worse or slower; they exist so a bad result can be attributed to Photonic or to the content.
Treat every surface as white. Isolates whether an artifact comes from texture sampling or the tracer.
Stop pushing texel samples out of solid geometry. Leaving it on shows the dark halos where a texel straddles a wall base and its sample ends up behind the surface.
Shade at the flat triangle position rather than the Phong-tessellated one. Leaving it on shows low-poly curved surfaces self-shadowing in facets.
Draw bounce directions per sample instead of from the precomputed low-discrepancy table. Slower, and only interesting when checking whether the table is causing visible structure.
